# 4E Logic

> A small workshop in Bath, Somerset, England, making hand-cut wooden logic puzzles: burr puzzles, tangrams, sliding-block trays and secret-opening puzzle boxes in beech, walnut and maple. Ages 8 and up.

- [Burr puzzles](https://4elogic.com/burr-puzzles.html): six-piece beech £18, twelve-piece walnut £34
- [Tangrams](https://4elogic.com/tangrams.html): tangram set and pattern book £22
- [Sliding blocks and puzzle boxes](https://4elogic.com/sliding-block-puzzles.html): tray £28, 3-move box £32, 9-move box £58
- [Order puzzles](https://4elogic.com/order-puzzles.html)
- [Delivery](https://4elogic.com/delivery-information.html) · [Returns](https://4elogic.com/puzzle-returns.html)

Contact: puzzles@4elogic.com
